name: Immersive Brand Hero
purpose: Create a high-impact first impression around one strong visual idea.
compositionNotes: Use when the page needs emotional impact; keep brand/product signal concrete.

name: Manifesto Section
purpose: State the brand belief or campaign thesis.
compositionNotes: Use large typography, but do not obscure meaning.

name: Cinematic Feature Sequence
purpose: Reveal product/brand features as a dramatic sequence.
compositionNotes: Use 3-5 moments, not an endless scroll.

name: Asymmetric Proof Grid
purpose: Show proofs, features, or artifacts with dynamic composition.
compositionNotes: Maintain alignment rules even when layout feels expressive.

name: Interactive Showcase
purpose: Highlight interaction or motion as part of the concept.
compositionNotes: Interaction should communicate value, not just decoration.

name: Editorial Split Story
purpose: Create rhythm with alternating text and visual panels.
compositionNotes: Good after the hero to slow down and explain.

name: Press and Awards Band
purpose: Add credibility without reducing creative energy.

name: Bold Final CTA
purpose: End with a memorable, decisive action.
compositionNotes: Echo the hero concept instead of introducing a new style.
